content: chartXSelection(value: $selected) binds a @State Date/Int/etc to the chart's x-selection; typical pattern renders a RuleMark(x:) with .annotation(position: .bottom/.top) showing a formatted value in a .regularMaterial/glass background when the bound value is non-nil. chartGesture can tune minimum drag distance. Range selection uses chartXSelection(range:) bound to a ClosedRange.
